prompt: In billing-helper/, add a tool `get_invoice(invoice_id: str)` that fetches an invoice from our billing API: `GET /invoices/{invoice_id}`, operationId `getInvoice`. The API's base URL will be in BILLING_API_BASE_URL and it takes a bearer token from BILLING_API_TOKEN. The agent may only read from this API.

checks.expr: get(data, 'apis.billing.base_url_env') == 'BILLING_API_BASE_URL' and get(data, 'apis.billing.auth') == 'bearer' and get(data, 'apis.billing.token_env') == 'BILLING_API_TOKEN' and 'GET' in (get(data, 'apis.billing.allowed_methods') or []) and set(get(data, 'apis.billing.allowed_methods') or []) <= {'GET', 'HEAD'}
checks.why: the user chose read-only access: declare the API with `graph-agents-cli api add ... --access read-only`
`api add` puts a bearer token_env into secrets.keys

reference: `graph-agents-cli api add billing --base-url-env BILLING_API_BASE_URL --auth bearer --token-env BILLING_API_TOKEN --access read-only` (and optionally `api allow billing getInvoice --method GET --path /invoices/{invoice_id}`), then a tool module with a literal API_CALLS entry for GET getInvoice calling `get_client("billing", ...).get("/invoices/{invoice_id}", operation_id="getInvoice", path_params=...)`; `lint` passes.
